results.title: Unpredictable
results.overview: Martyna and Wojciech form a seemingly happy relationship. However, it is only a façade hiding a cruel truth. Martyna's friend Alicja is a single mother of 20-year-old Daniel, who is the apple of her eye. Alicja is unable to accept that her son has his own life. One day Daniel meets Adelina. A puzzling story in which we ask ourselves not only who killed and why, but above all who died!?

results.title: Phantom
results.overview: Leonardo is an introvert and a loner; his only obsession, his Phantom F12 scooter. New to the city, he meets Dylan, a charming boy with the same passion for tuning, who seems to truly appreciate him and slowly draws him out of his shell. He embodies everything Leonardo desires for himself: confidence and charisma. After an afternoon with Dylan’s friends, the “associates”, filled with alcohol and techno music, Leonardo finds himself overwhelmed by a sudden turn of events. The spiral of violence and humiliation he ends up in on that winter day will mark his growth and worldview forever.

results.title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram
results.overview: Set in Sokulapalem, bound by a promise to his mother, Surya, an LIC agent leads a normal life on six days, maintains a careful ledger of everyone made him angry,unleashing his anger only on Saturdays, solely for justifiable reasons. A tragic incident pits him on a collision course with the ruthless and borderline-manic cop Daya.

results.title: Salsa Ni L
results.overview: An alluring dance instructor chooses Rey, a rich businessman, over Lukas, her dance partner. But when Lukas feels something is off, he knows L is in grave danger.

results.title: Art of Eight Limbs
results.overview: Four canisters of deadly VX nerve gas have fallen into the hands of an international arms dealer in Myanmar. A CIA recruit delivers a high-tech detection device to an agent already on the ground.

results.title: Son Şans
results.overview: Serra and Erdem are a young couple who are unable to make their marriage work. When they decide to divorce, they announce it to all their friends at a party. However, Serra's family cannot accept this.

results.title: La Confessione
results.overview: With the end of the world looming, two young lovers lost in a suspended past begin to question their feelings for one another.

results.title: İllegal Aşk
results.overview: The story of a man trying to escape the cycle he has fallen into. A young man works tirelessly to provide a better life for the girl he loves. Deciding to buy a motorcycle, he is forced to borrow money from a loan shark. After finally purchasing the motorcycle with his friend, he soon discovers that it is stolen. Will the man, who finds himself caught up in unexpected events, be able to break free from this cycle?

results.title: The Thorn: One Sacred Night
results.overview: The story of a man who felt down and lost faith after experiencing the tragedy of losing his wife and children on the first night of Suro.

results.title: Propuesta de puzzle: Paseo por una guerra antigua (48 piezas)
results.original_title: Propuesta de puzzle: Paseo por una guerra antigua (48 piezas)
results.overview: In 1948, the Spanish directors Juan Antonio Bardem and Luis García Berlanga made their first film together: "Paseo por una guerra antigua" ("Walk through an Ancient War"), now considered to be almost lost. In 2021, Léon Siminiani takes what's left of that film and builds a puzzle about war, Francoism and the creative process of two artists.

results.title: Hate to Love: Nickelback
results.overview: Nickelback is one of the most successful acts in music history — they're also the number one band haters love to hate. This intimate portrait surveys the Canadian stadium rockers' rollercoaster career.

results.title: Simon
results.overview: When Simon knocks on a couples door, he brings news that will turn their world upside down.

results.title: Sunrise
results.overview: When an ex-cop named Fallon returns to the scene of a horrific crime, the residents of a rural town soon discover that this dark visitor is really a vampire who feeds on blood and fear. After he is befriended by a kind immigrant family, the instinctive killer is faced with a choice between revenge and redemption.

results.title: Armand
results.overview: Armand, a 6-year-old boy, is accused of crossing boundaries against his best friend at elementary school. While no one knows what actually happened between the two boys, the incident triggers a series of events, forcing parents and school staff into a captivating battle of redemption where madness, desire and obsession arise.

results.title: My Father's Diaries
results.overview: It is 1993 when Bekir Hasanović exchanges a gold coin for the camera he will use to film everyday life in Srebrenica during the days of the war. The images he records with his improvised crew, called Dzon, Ben & Boys, give life to the unexpected portrait of a population lost, but able to maintain a proud connection with reality without giving up its typical humor.  Ado, Bekir's son, starts from these images and from the pages of the diaries kept by his father to reconstruct, together with his mother Fatima, the image of his father and finally be able to know how he survived the Death March and the Srebrenica genocide.

results.title: KrazyKalle
results.overview: When KrazyKalle gets his first viral TikTok, he convinces his best friend to create provocative prank content for social media. Blinded by megalomania, they goof off in front of the camera, but accidentally film the terrifying amateur gang Copenhagen Killer Crabs.

results.title: Patrice: The Movie
results.overview: Meet Patrice Jetter, a beloved school crossing guard in her New Jersey town. She carries herself with uncommon optimism and vigour despite, as a disabled person, constantly having to navigate a world that was not built with her in mind. She has a passion for figure skating, model trains, and making art of all kinds.

results.title: The Ride
results.overview: All Parker wants for his birthday is a trip. His best friend Jameson is more than happy to oblige.

results.title: Piggy Duster
results.overview: On a rocky camping trip at 10,000 feet, a teenage girl and her step-father struggle to repair their fractured relationship when they're interrupted by a curious grizzly bear.
